messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz leaves the Atlas team and joins the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman (Tomasz left the Atlas team on 2025-07-30 to join the Dune team). [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, having moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2026-04-14, Farah holds the Dune team pager, taking over from Tomasz. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Dune team, taking over from Farah. [valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah is the primary on-call for the Dune team. [valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- On 2026-05-22 the Dune team reported that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah. [valid 2025-09-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
    earlier: Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-13 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
- As of 2025-10-15, Farah holds the Dune team pager this cycle, taking over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-15]
- As of 2025-12-10, Tomasz holds the Dune team pager this cycle, taking over from Farah. [valid 2025-12-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-17, Farah still holds the Dune team pager. [valid 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-17]
- As of 2026-05-22, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22]
- On 2026-02-16 the Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- On 2026-05-22 the Dune team noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-2]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2026-05-19, the job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-05-28 the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
